Blazing Youth, Chapter 133: Any Resemblance is Purely Coincidental

November 12th, Wednesday, sunny.

The annual sports meet of Yuhang No. 1 Affiliated High School was about to unfold on the field tomorrow.

Around six in the evening, student council members with work badges on their chests were already walking back and forth on the field, handling various materials and arrangements for the sports meet.

Because he was a member of the rock band, Li Luo was assigned to the backstage of the main stage to check and tune the various instruments with the music teacher.

Watching Li Luo casually tap out a melody on the electronic keyboard, Teacher Jiang, standing beside him, raised his eyebrows. "I remember you're the guitarist, right? You know how to play the keyboard too?"

"I know a little of everything," Li Luo said with a modest smile. After confirming the keyboard's sound pickup was fine, he moved to the drum set and tapped out a rhythm with surprising skill.

"Now you're just being too modest," Teacher Jiang said with a laugh. "You've learned the drums quite well too."

In truth, Li Luo had barely learned it at all.

This was just a new application of his memory palace that he had recently discovered.

Or rather, it was a skill he had slowly mastered after long-term and increasingly proficient use of the memory palace.

Li Luo tentatively called it soul possession.

In reality, it was just because for a long time now, he had been watching the other rock band members play their instruments almost every day.

Over time, the detailed movements of their every performance were etched into his mind.

Especially after the same song was played many times, Li Luo would superimpose each memory, replay it repeatedly in his memory palace, and after achieving a certain consistency with his own body, he could attempt a one-to-one replication.

It might be a little stiff at first, but his memory was so incredibly clear that after just a little practice, he could get into the zone and complete the replication.

Of course, this was currently limited to replication. For now, Li Luo could only play "Brave Heart" and "Life in Full Bloom."

He wasn't as skilled with other songs as he was with his own guitar playing; he still needed to study seriously to completely master an instrument.

But if he wanted to start learning a new instrument, it would definitely be much easier for him than for others.

Just as Li Luo and Teacher Jiang were checking the instruments, Wei Duo, a second-year student, walked into the backstage area from outside and said to a student council member, "Class president, the teacher wants you in the office."

"Oh, got it." The class president responded, said a few words to the student next to him, and then hurried to the teacher's office.

Wei Duo had originally intended to leave after running her errand, but her gaze swept over the newly moved instruments backstage, and she couldn't help but look surprised.

"Teacher Jiang," Wei Duo asked, looking puzzled, "is our rock band's performance still on? I thought we didn't get it approved."

"It is," Teacher Jiang said, nodding at Wei Duo. "Oh, you've been busy with the competition recently, so you probably don't know. Niu Qingling's side managed to scrape together enough people. This here is the guitarist."

With that, Teacher Jiang patted Li Luo's shoulder by way of introduction.

Guitarist?

Wei Duo's gaze fell on Li Luo, and she had a vague impression of him.

Although Li Luo hadn't joined their rock band before, he often came over with Yan Zhusheng, and when they were short on people, he would pick up a guitar and fill in.

But... the rock band was short a lead singer, which was her position. Wasn't Xie Shuchen from the first year the guitarist?

"He's the guitarist, so what about Xie Shuchen?" Wei Duo asked, surprised.

"Xie Shuchen has studied piano, so he's picking up the keyboard quite fast," Teacher Jiang said.

Hearing that Xie Shuchen was on keyboard, Wei Duo was even more bewildered. "Xie Shuchen is on keyboard, so don't tell me Yan Zhusheng is the lead singer?"

"She is," Teacher Jiang said with a smile. "If you hadn't gone to the competition, I wouldn't have known Yan Zhusheng was such an amazing singer. She performed once at the parent-teacher conference, and it was spectacular."

Teacher Jiang was clearly not very tactful. As soon as he said this, Wei Duo's expression soured.

But in front of a teacher, she couldn't say much.

In fact, her decision to give up the sports meet performance was mainly due to preparing for the competition, but there were other factors as well.

For instance, she didn't actually like the two songs chosen for the sports meet, and they weren't her strongest genre.

Also, after the National Day holiday, the previous band leader quit and gave the position to Niu Qingling instead of her, Wei Duo.

And besides that... there was Yan Zhusheng.

When Wei Duo was in the rock band, she was the best-looking girl in the entire group.

As for others like Niu Qingling, her arms were thick from drumming, which was particularly unattractive.

And none of the third-year seniors who had already quit were prettier than her.

This made her very popular and well-regarded in the rock band.

But since the start of the school year, Yan Zhusheng had joined, and the halo that had once focused on Wei Duo was suddenly shattered.

This made Wei Duo a little uncomfortable.

Especially since Yan Zhusheng seemed to be good at everything. Whenever they were short-staffed on an instrument, she could easily fill in, playing it with ease, sometimes even outshining the original player.

With top-tier ability and looks, she had instantly overshadowed Wei Duo, the flower of the rock band.

But now you're telling her that Yan Zhusheng can also be the lead singer, and sings better than her?

A girl's voice wasn't well-suited for those two rock songs in the first place. How good could Yan Zhusheng possibly be?

Wei Duo was completely unconvinced. She just felt that Teacher Jiang was blaming her for backing out at a critical moment, affecting his performance review and bonus from the school.

However, she maintained a polite expression and said with a smile, "Then I wish our rock band the best of luck and a successful performance. I have other things to do, so I'll be going now."

After watching Wei Duo leave, Teacher Jiang stretched and said to Li Luo, "The checks are about done. I'm heading out too. You guys do your best tomorrow."

"Okay, goodbye, Teacher Jiang."

During the evening self-study session, the five members of the rock band went to the backstage area of the main stage for their final practice before the sports meet.

During a break, Shao Youpeng suddenly said, "Sister Niu, did Wei Duo look for you today?"

"No, what's up?" Niu Qingling paused. "She looked for you? What for?"

"She just asked about the rock band," Shao Youpeng said. "She thought we wouldn't be performing because we couldn't get enough people. She probably just heard that we're still performing."

"And then?"

"And then..." Shao Youpeng chuckled, glanced at Yan Zhusheng, and shrugged. "She made a few sarcastic comments to me, saying that Yan Zhusheng is still a first-year and lacks performance experience, telling me to take good care of her and all, so she doesn't get too nervous."

"I was thinking, does Yan Zhusheng even need me to take care of her?"

"We'll be lucky if she doesn't get too hyped up on stage and yank the microphone cord out."

Hearing this, Xie Shuchen frowned. "When she first joined the band, I thought Senior Wei Duo seemed nice. Why would she say something like that?"

"That's just how she is," Niu Qingling said with a pout. "As long as no one is better looking than her, she's super confident. And when the old leader didn't pick her, she even made fun of me behind my back."

"Uh..." Xie Shuchen's mouth fell open, and then he scratched his head. "Senior Wei Duo isn't that good-looking, is she?"

"True," Shao Youpeng said with a nod. "Can't hold a candle to Xu Youyu from our class."

"Or a single finger of Ying Chanxi from our class."

"She's also not as good-looking as our Yan Zhusheng," Li Luo said with a smile, holding his guitar. "Let's not worry about others. We just need to do our own thing."

Yan Zhusheng had been listening without much concern, but when Li Luo praised her, she tilted her head and looked at him, blinking.

After the second period of evening self-study ended, the five of them packed up and left the backstage area, heading toward the classroom building.

Yan Zhusheng turned her head and asked, "Then, Li Luo, who do you think is the prettiest? Me, Xixi, or the senior?"

"Why are you asking a question like that?"

"Curious."

"Each has their own merits."

"But you wrote in your book that Mo Qinghan is the one with the most exquisite features, in terms of looks alone."

Yan Zhusheng knew the descriptions in Li Luo's book like the back of her hand.

"Shen Dongdong is feisty and cute, with a natural youthful air, like a white and tender lotus emerging untainted from the summer lake's mud."

"And Jiang Mingyue's mature aura, combined with her easygoing private personality, creates a sharp contrast. Paired with her perfect figure, it showcases a kind of tantalizing charm through its incongruity."

At this point, Yan Zhusheng nodded and concluded, "So I'm prettier."

The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. He thought to himself that he never should have shown her the draft.

Besides.

"You recited the descriptions of Shen Dongdong and Jiang Mingyue so completely, why didn't you finish Mo Qinghan's?"

"Mmm..." Yan Zhusheng looked down at her own feet, her brow furrowed with a hint of unhappiness. "Li Luo is a bad person."

"Ahem, I must emphasize one point." Li Luo coughed twice and reminded her in a serious tone, "The characters I write are all fictional. Please do not connect them to reality. Any resemblance is purely coincidental."

(End of Chapter)
